news.title: Jefferies lifts its Tesla target to $400 from $350 but stays at Hold
news.summary: Jefferies cited resilient deliveries and better prospects for FSD software, energy storage and robotaxis, while modeling Q3 revenue of $29.2B, a 16.7% auto gross margin and roughly $5B of cash outflow. Tesla reports Q3 after the close on Oct. 21.

news.title: NHTSA opens a review of claims robotaxis speed in school zones
news.summary: NHTSA's defects office will evaluate a petition (with three video links) alleging Cybercab and Model Y vehicles on the Automated Driving System exceed limits in active school zones, covering about 1,000 2026-model-year vehicles. It will then decide whether to open a full investigation. TSLA closed down 1.2% at $378.03.

news.title: 300+ Cybercabs now serve Austin; Tesla hints Dallas is next
news.summary: Tesla's Robotaxi account said the Austin Cybercab fleet passed 300, an 8x increase in 30 days, and AI chief Ashok Elluswamy replied "Dallas soon" (no launch date announced). NHTSA gave Tesla until Oct 30 to answer 21 questions on the pedal-free Cybercab's safety compliance. TSLA rose ~0.6% overnight after a 3% gain last week.

news.title: Week in review: China discounts, a Europe rename for FSD, and a Georgia Megacharger
news.summary: Tesla is offering 5,000–7,000 yuan discounts on Model 3/Y in China, which could lift volume but squeeze margins before the Oct 21 Q3 report. In Europe it is renaming "Full Self-Driving (Supervised)" to "Tesla Assisted Driving" as regulators probe the name, and it opened a 1.2-MW Semi Megacharger at a Pilot station in Georgia.

news.title: Tesla China September wholesale sales rise 5% to 95,366
news.summary: China Passenger Car Association data: Shanghai-built Model 3/Y sales (domestic plus export) rose 5% YoY to 95,366 in September, a year-to-date high and the 11th straight month of YoY growth.

news.title: Tesla closes up 2.1% at $382.70 on China sales
news.summary: TSLA traded as high as $388.56 and closed at $382.70 (+2.05%) on lighter-than-average volume, helped by the China sales data, a 50-truck Semi order from IMC Logistics and robotaxi/AI optimism ahead of Q3 earnings on Oct 21.

news.title: Why is Tesla stock rallying today?
news.summary: Tigress Financial kept its Buy rating and $550 target, and the Texas Cybercab fleet reached 319 registered vehicles after 150 were added on Oct 8 (about 739 autonomous vehicles including modified Model Ys).

news.title: Tesla leaned on Dutch regulator to ease its FSD review, emails show
news.summary: Eight EU countries now allow FSD (Supervised); the bloc-wide vote has slipped to December at the earliest, with Germany, Italy and Spain still undecided. TSLA closed −0.7% at $375.00.

news.title: UBS raises Tesla target to $391 from $385, keeps Buy
news.summary: UBS's Joseph Spak calls the risk/reward 'tactically favorable' and says Tesla is more sentiment- than results-driven; TSLA closed down 0.8% at $377.81.

news.title: Musk welcomes German backing for FSD as Tesla chases EU approval
news.summary: Germany's transport minister backs prompt EU approval and accepts FSD exceeding speed limits by up to 10%; Sweden and France have concerns, and the EU vote has slipped from October to at least December. A Reuters special report detailed Tesla's European lobbying campaign.

news.title: Germany pushes EU on FSD approval
news.summary: An EU committee discussed FSD (Supervised) without a vote; a decision is expected in December, and Germany may approve on its own.

news.title: Cybercab under pressure to expand after rocky first month in Austin
news.summary: 169 Cybercabs now authorized for commercial use in Texas (up from 45); Tesla got an extension on an NHTSA audit query.
